messages.subject: App runs locally but not on glimmer
parts:
Dear Shiny Team,

I am developing an app which works fine locally but gives an error "The application unexpectedly exited" in glimmer (http://glimmer.rstudio.com/brbnci/BasketTrials/). Can you please help me in resolving this?

Thanks,
Jyothi

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: App runs locally but not on glimmer
parts:
Jyothi,

I was able to capture this error from the application log:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:39261
Shiny URLs starting with /tableinput will mapped to /home/brbnci/R/library/shinyIncubator/tableinput
Shiny URLs starting with /tableinput will mapped to /home/brbnci/R/library/shinyIncubator/tableinput
Error in handler(binary, message) :
  No handler registered for for type interimdata:matrix

This seems similar to an issue reported in the following thread on March 14, regarding shinyIncubator:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/VJOMXIn9GUw

So your issue is most likely an incompatibility between shinyIncubator, and latest version of Shiny package. 

What version of Shiny are you running locally?


Fereshteh
